mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_run (user_id, model, page_context, request_id, run_type) VALUES (#{userId}, #{model}, #{pageContext}, #{requestId}, #{runType})

INSERT INTO ai_agent_tool_call (run_id, sequence_no, provider_call_id, tool_name, arguments_summary, result_summary, success, duration_ms, error_message) VALUES (#{runId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{providerCallId}, #{toolName}, #{argumentsSummary}, #{resultSummary}, #{success}, #{durationMs}, #{errorMessage})
